description: Prepare a video as a file and return a download link: MP4 (H.264 + AAC, plays everywhere) by default, or another format — WebM, MOV, MKV, MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, Opus, a looping GIF or animated WebP of up to 10 s. The link works for 15 minutes after the last request. Long videos may still be preparing when this returns: then call check_export with the export_id. Counts against the caller's daily limit (40 per IP).

end.description: Optional: end of the part to keep, in seconds (after start).

format.description: File format: mp4 (H.264 + AAC, plays everywhere), webm (VP9 + Opus, for the web), mov (H.264 + AAC, for Apple editors), mkv (the site’s own codecs when possible), mp3 (192 kbps), m4a (AAC 192 kbps), wav (uncompressed, for editing), flac (lossless), opus (128 kbps, smallest), gif (plays anywhere), webp (animated, sharper and smaller). Default: mp4, or mp3 / gif for those qualities.

item.description: Which video of a multi-video post (1-based); see get_video_info.

quality.description: Resolution cap (the smaller side, so vertical videos count the same). "audio" gives sound only; "gif" a looping GIF or WebP of a selection up to 10 s (set start and end). Leave it out with an audio or loop format.

start.description: Optional: start of the part to keep, in seconds.

url.description: Link to a public post or video (YouTube, Instagram, X / Twitter, TikTok, Bluesky, Facebook, VK, LinkedIn, Weibo, Twitch, Kick).

name: download_video
title: Download video
